_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: THE ACCEPTED DEVELOPMENT CANDIDATE 938e00d8 = 74d19281 (the served pin, run 52) PLUS ONE FIRST-PARENT INTEGRATION on claude/wsf-app-shell: COMMUNITY-SETTINGS-PARITY-1 (W9 #506, product ffb517e5), accepted by the Director (#506 5846465707) and integrated by merge commit 938e00d8 (L0 #506 5846474990). Released for this pin under the owner's stable-change staging cadence (L0 #396 5846476221). WHAT CHANGES FOR MEMBERS OVER 74d19281: the 62 px shared top bar and tab-bar metrics on every member tab; the Community tab's banner ring and fact rows, with the selected community first, and its role fact reading "Champion"; Settings as a 12 px inset side panel with a × Close, its privacy sections listing the selected community first, with the cache-only formatted hint. The banner ring ships as committed PNGs (assets/brand/derived/banner-ring*.png); the offline renderer scripts/westayfit/render-banner-ring.mjs that produced them is not on any build or runtime path. NO NEW FUNCTION, NO REMOVED FUNCTION, NO BACKEND CHANGE: functions-westayfit is tree-identical (5a3f232e) and still exports 49, so the reviewed expectation for the deploy of this pin is 49 -> 49 with CREATED_THIS_DEPLOY=none. The three social callables (wsfSetCommunityVisibility, wsfCommunityMembers, wsfCommunityActivity) were CREATED BY RUN 47 (35937603929) and stay listed in candidateAddedFunctions because the verifier's expected set is its 46-name base plus that list; removing them while they remain deployed is invalid. LIMITATIONS CARRIED, NONE CLEARED BY THIS PIN: the three social services were measured TRANSPORT-SHUT on runs 47 to 52 (run 52 36238227254, invoker_iam_check_enabled) and stay SHUT until Operation 2 is performed by an operator with the access and read back (docs/wsf-staging/OPERATOR-HANDOFF-social-staging.md); VERIFY=pass with the three SHUT is an inventory and transport report, not a working feature. THE ONE wsfContributions COMPOSITE INDEX HAS NO READY RECEIPT and this workflow never deploys indexes (SINGLE-INDEX-OPERATOR-PROCEDURE.md). Both are post-deploy FEATURE-READINESS blockers for the served claim of the social features, not dispatch holds (skills/wsf-staging-deploy/SKILL.md). EMAIL DELIVERY BLOCKED AT RUNTIME; SIGNUP SMOKE INCOMPLETE (separate operator track). KIOSK HOLD UNCHANGED: shared and unattended kiosk use remains HELD by the owner. NODE.JS 20 FUNCTIONS RUNTIME: functions-westayfit declares engines.node 20, and the functions deploys through run 52 printed that Node.js 20 was deprecated on 2026-04-30 and will be decommissioned on 2026-10-30, after which deploys fail without an upgrade; noted, not changed by this pin. No rankings, no streaks, no health data, no photo collection, no coaching upsell, no forced sharing. No production change.
